title: Backup Validation & Recoverability Assurance Program
author_notes: Derived from a Microsoft Cloud Solution Architect (MSP) requirement: drive operational resilience through backup validation.

Scope: a program that proves backups restore — M365 (Exchange/SPO/OneDrive/Teams via 3rd-party SaaS backup) + Azure Backup — with coverage standards, RPO/RTO, a scheduled restore-test cadence, per-workload test restores, evidence capture, and audit-ready reporting. White-label.
pricing: T3 (advanced) — multi-workload assurance program + evidence + reporting.
